text_block_list.text:
While walking around town, accompanying 
Agnes Digital in her search for Umamusume 
merch—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! There's a huge line up ahead. I 
wonder what kind of merch they're selling?

"It might not necessarily be selling 
goods. Peeking inside just to check—"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! You there, Umamusume 
with the big ribbon, wanna try your luck?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The Last One Prize is Umamusume merch!? 
In that case, I have to draw until it's 
completely empty!"

Stopping Agnes Digital as she tried to 
reach into her wallet without looking, we 
decided to pull just once.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... Only one entry ticket... No 
matter what the prizes are, a situation 
like this really gets my blood pumping!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even if the odds for Umamusume-chan merch 
are slim, let's roll believing we'll get 
something close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ready, and―― Umasu!!

Chanting some mysterious incantation, we 
joined forces and turned the raffle 
wheel's crank!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaa, not just Prize A... It's the GRAND 
PRIZEee!! Godly pull, absolutely godly!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have travel vouchers... 
Trainer, we have no choice but to carry 
out THAT plan! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's a vacation, a vacation! A 2-day trip 
to talk endlessly about horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A 3-year compilation! From newly debuted, 
tiny little Umamusume-chans, to gorgeous, 
refined Umamusume ladies!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's stay up all night talking about our 
Twinkle memories! Right after we blaze 
through all 12 cours!

It seems Agnes Digital has already 
completely planned out the tour itinerary.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, to make it a godly event, we need 
to stock up on way, way more memories~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, Trainer. Please hold 
onto these tickets we won until the 
fateful day arrives.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Until that day comes! Digi-tan wants 
to...!! Become everyone's photo albummm!!!

"To build up even more legendary tales to 
tell, Agnes Digital was boiling with more 
heat than a hot spring from the very start 
of the year."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Prize B... wait no, 1st Prize! Must 
record this emotion, ●REC, ●REC!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"... 
Aaah, I want to eat this hamburg steak 
with some side dishes~!
choice_data_list:
Isn't the hamburger steak supposed to be 
the side dish?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, to make delicious food taste even 
better, you need a topping of imagination, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A warm, fluffy, giant hamburger steak... 
And a bunch of cheerful Umamusume gathered 
around it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining it is enough to make me 
scarf down three bowls of rice! And I can 
eat this hamburg steak right along with 
it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's head back and start our 
imaginary dinner. Join in, Trainer, join 
in!

Afterward, while fantasizing about a Round 
Table of Umamusume, Agnes Digital and I 
enjoyed a delicious hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a whole mountain of it. Looks like we 
got their entire stock.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even so, nyufufu... The more you look at 
those carrots, the more they resemble the 
Umamusume, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Like, look, that one on the end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It looks slender and stiff on the outside, 
but the inside seems really soft... Just 
like Taishin-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The little one next to it is Akebono-san's 
collarbone, and the leafy one is Fuji-san 
wearing a wig...♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, depending on the angle too! This 
might actually speed things up~."

Her sense of what makes something 
"Umamusume-like" was unique. Agnes Digital 
savored each one with delight, carefully 
examining them as she ate.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just one carrot... Well, I suppose that's 
expected for a single try.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. I already know. Setting up a 
raffle takes a lot of hard work, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Coming up with a merch lineup from 
scratch, sourcing it, and arranging it on 
shelves like this takes quite a lot of 
effort, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Expecting to win the top prize reigning 
over all the rest with just a single draw 
is the height of arrogance!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Supporting your oshi is what it's all 
about. That's my default state, after all. 
Mm-hmm...

On the way back, Agnes Digital savored the 
carrot she received, looking as though she 
had achieved complete enlightenment.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, tissues... Couldn't they at least 
have an Umamusume print on them 
somewhere~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, seems like there's nothing~. It 
really is just a pack of ordinary real 
tissues...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, might be better than getting pocket 
tissues handed out on the street...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If a stranger suddenly hands you 
something, you'd freak out and run away, 
right? *sigh*...

Still, a consolation prize is still just a 
consolation prize. Agnes Digital looked a 
little downhearted.
